summary: #smallpoems I know so little of sports well the rules and game, yes playing the game, no yet I coach and coach well granted I coach when foundations form but basically I get 15 eight year olds to stand in a a line that's my skill. Maybe teaching writing is the same?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
I know so little of sports
well the rules and game, yes
playing the game, no
yet I coach
and coach well
granted I coach when foundations form
but basically
I get 15 eight year olds to stand in a a line
that's my skill.
Maybe teaching writing is the same?
